notes.title: Dungeon Story Dev Log v0.0.1.1
notes.notes:
Dear Players,
This is the developer of Dungeon Story.

[Latest Feature Updates]
◆ Warriors and Mages now each have a new starting skill to ease early-game difficulty
◆ Chest Mimics are now guaranteed to spawn on Floor 2, always dropping a rare reward
◆ Defeating any monster now guarantees at least one skill reward
◆ Enhanced card art visualization – numerical changes are now more visually distinct
◆ Added dynamic screen shake effects based on damage dealt

The game will receive continuous updates in the future. Thank you for your support!
